entities.summary: Ottoman, a notable figure in the history of Cyprus, associated with Venetian and Ottoman Cyprus (1489–1571). Their legacy influenced Fall of Famagusta after 11-month siege; Bragadin flayed alive and Ottoman forces besiege and capture Nicosia in a single assault.
